mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC > -0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor market strength (PAYEMS > 143000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicate robust economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS > 143000 and UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC > -0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1600 thousand units indicate strong demand for residential construction, boosting related sectors and consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when RSAFS > 560000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO > 107.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
